title: All-hands March 2026 - draft talking points & Q&A
body:
Goal: Draft speaking notes for All-Hands (Mar 2026) - high level company update + product focus + what we need from the org. This is a scratchpad, expect edits.

Opening (30s)
- Quick welcome, thank everyone for the sprint after the holidays. Call out new hires (brief): 12 new engineers, growth in SRE and Private deployment teams.
- One-liner reminder of mission: make predictable, affordable inference for engineers.

Company health (1 min)
- Revenue/usage snapshot: ARR runway is healthy; hosted API growth continues. (TODO: get precise revenue % growth from finance - ask Jordan.)
- Usage metrics to call out: total monthly tokens up ~[INSERT %] vs Feb; Dedicated customers increased by [INSERT #]. (Lucas: need final numbers by 3/3)
- Ops: uptime remains at SLA targets; one incident in Feb (brief summary + what we fixed).

Product highlights (2-3 min)
- Redwood Optimize beta: rolled out to 10 pilot customers, early feedback shows 20-40% cost reduction on high-throughput workloads. Mention one customer quote (ask Solutions for permission).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): shipped new KMS/HSM integration in private preview - important for enterprise deals.
- Serving runtime: merged attention-optimization kernels and experimental 4-bit quant path that reduced GPU memory by ~30% on internal tests. Call out perf numbers in slide (Priya to verify).
- Console updates: per-route latency dashboards and rollout controls (canary/A-B) are live in beta for Dedicated customers.

Customer & GTM wins (1 min)
- Highlight 2 customer wins: one mid-market SaaS adopting Dedicated, one enterprise pilot for private deployment in EMEA. (Use anonymized names if needed.)
- Sales motion: PLG signups converting earlier; enterprise motion is ramping - mention partnership with channel team in APAC.

What we're focused on next quarter (1-2 min)
- Stability & SLOs: SRE + infra to reduce p99 generation latency by X% (engineering: define X).
- Scale: increase Dedicated capacity with new reserved SKUs (release plan in Release Engineering doc).
- Observability & cost tooling: finish token-level cost breakdown and automated suggestions from Optimize.
- Private: complete on-prem packaging and documentation for regulated customers.

People & hiring (30s)
- Hiring priorities: SRE, infra, solutions engineering for Private.
- Reminder: interview training sessions next week; managers please schedule 1:1 calibration.

Call to action / what we need from the company (30s)
- Engineers: prioritize SLO-driven bugs in the next sprint; shortlist top three perf regressions.
- Product/Docs: finish Private onboarding docs + runbook for KMS integration.
- Sales/SEs: gather two high-value customer testimonials for Optimize beta.

Q&A (anticipated) - prep notes and suggested answers
Q: Are we still on track to hit our Q2 revenue/usage targets?
A: Yes, pacing is healthy but we need a few larger Dedicated deals to close; finance will share a 1-page update in the follow-up. (Follow-up: Jordan to confirm exact % of target).

Q: What happened in the Feb incident and how will we prevent recurrence?
A: Root cause was autoscaling policy edge case + a bug in routing fallback. We added a safety guard and tightened canary criteria. SRE will present a postmortem slide during the QA.

Q: How does Redwood Optimize fit with the hosted API vs Dedicated/Private?
A: It's designed as a cross-deployment toolkit: hosted gets algorithmic batching/caching improvements we manage; Dedicated/Private get configuration suggestions and a lightweight agent that reports metrics for optimization.

Q: Is the new quantization path ready for production?
A: Not yet - internal tests are promising but we need more validation across 3rd-party models and add automated quality regressions checks. Expected production readiness: late Q2 (tentative).

Q: Any layoffs/organizational changes?
A: No. Focus is on targeted hiring and org tweaks to support Private and SRE scale.

Notes to self / TODOs
- Pull exact metrics: monthly tokens, ARR growth %, Dedicated customer count (Lucas/Jordan).
- Get one short customer quote for Optimize from SE team (Priya).
- Add slide with Feb incident postmortem (SRE).
- Confirm new-hire list and brief bios for welcome slide (People Ops).
- Finalize speaking order and time allocations by 3/4 EOD.

Formatting / presentation notes
- Keep slides light: 1-2 bullets per slide, data calls on a single metrics slide.
- Use anonymized customer names or customer initials unless we have permission.
- Reserve last 10 minutes for live Q&A; collect questions via Slido and Slack #all-hands ahead of time.

Draft closing lines (options):
- Option A: "We're in a strong position - the next quarter is about scaling responsibly and shipping the bits that make inference predictable and cheaper for our customers. Thank you."
- Option B: "Great execution so far - let's keep the focus on SLOs, Private readiness, and making Optimize broadly useful. We've got a busy quarter ahead."

Rough timing: 12-15 minutes of remarks + 10-15 minutes Q&A.

End of draft.

Edits welcome - pull requests to the deck (GH link above) or comment here.
